name: cc-lookup-struct-tag-soft
interface_notes: Strict versus soft tag lookup; an absent descriptor returns zero without allocating a future identity. C14 reuses type-name lookup and C12 consumes descriptors.

name: cc-parse-struct-def
interface_notes: Pre-register the stable record identity before fields, append bounded legacy member forms and close the definition; self-reference is data recursion. Native incomplete-tag completion is planned for C23/G03.

name: cc-peek-fnptr?
interface_notes: Two-token function-pointer lookahead with complete lexer reset and balanced parameter-token skipping; this does not construct a checked signature. Native signature work is planned for G03.

name: cc-skip-fnptr-params
interface_notes: Two-token function-pointer lookahead with complete lexer reset and balanced parameter-token skipping; this does not construct a checked signature. Native signature work is planned for G03.

name: cc-parse-fnptr-decl
interface_notes: Restricted local function-pointer declaration, one-slot allocation and optional runtime initializer; C14 consumes the resulting local symbol in indirect calls.

name: cc-decl-base
interface_notes: Scalar/pointer/array declarator and local-static storage paths; distinguish runtime from builder-time initialization and current-token exit ownership. C14 supplies expression/constant parsing.

name: cc-parse-local-declarator

name: cc-parse-decl-with-base
